summary: Add admin role capabilities: admin can view all users and admin signup requires a special password.
architectural_notes: Admin signup is gated by a special password (currently provided by user). Ensure this secret is not hard-coded or exposed client-side.

existing_features.title: Ensure an admin can view a complete list of all registered users via the existing admin user management UI, and ensure non-admin users are blocked from accessing the user list.

Add an admin signup path where selecting the Admin role during signup requires entering the special admin signup password exactly: "Hans@987123"; if the password is missing or incorrect, the signup must fail with a clear, user-facing error message in English.

Update frontend signup error translation so that backend failures related to invalid/missing admin signup password are displayed as a concise, user-friendly English message without exposing internal details.

new_feature_requests.summary: Allow admin to see all users (admin user listing/access).
Require a special password to sign up as admin (admin signup gate).

projectName: Admin user listing and admin signup gated by special password
